positions.title: Principal Consultant
positions.description: Architect, develop and support a wide variety of data integration projects, core platform enhancements, and clinical portal web application customizations on the HealthShare InterSystems platform. Mentor and train other developers. Technologies used include Ensemble, Cache Objectscript, CSP, ZEN, XSLT, SOAP, REST, and CSS/HTML/JavaScript.

positions.title: Senior Systems Engineer
positions.description: Led design and development of web applications on the InterSystems HealthShare platform to support both clinical workflows and internal operations. Designed and developed an embeddable JavaScript-based widget for rapid service-based integration with partners and stakeholders. Provided end-user support to users of HIE clinical portal.

positions.title: Senior Programmer/Analyst
positions.description: Coded and optimized tree-based and clustering algorithms (in Java) to analyze medical ontologies. Worked with researchers to implement and customize Galaxy, an open-source bioinformatics platform built on Python/Django used to create genomic data analysis pipelines.

positions.title: Applications Developer/Analyst
positions.description: Gathered requirements, designed and developed additional features for a CDC research tool.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Tested and contributed to development of Model-Driven Health Tools, an open-source project based on OCL, Java, and Eclipse that eases development of CDA-based interoperability.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Design, develop, and implement a geographic information system for assessing accessibility to treatment in hybrid public health study - clinical trial.

positions.title: Associate
positions.description: Maintain and develop analytic financial software for credit products.
